# prescribed conduct

The conduct the norm is about — an event type, a goal (#350), a situation, or a rights action (via the #352 graft). The range is intentionally open (the tenurePosition precedent): asserting a closed range union would either dangle across module boundaries or vanish from the generated schema surface, and the graft would force dual-typing of the RightsAction vocabulary. NOT functional: one norm may govern several conducts jointly.
